'''Jessica Hart Steinmann''' (born February 5, 1984)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legistorm.com/person/bio/233604/Jessica_Hart_Steinmann.html|title=Incoming Rep. Jessica Steinmann - R Texas, 8th, Member-elect - America First Policy Institute (Jan. 2025-), Executive General Counsel/Litigation Vice Chair - Biography &#124; LegiStorm|website=www.legistorm.com}}</ref> is an American politician from [[Texas]]. A [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]], she is the member-elect for {{ushr|TX|8}} in the [[United States House of Representatives]].

Steinmann is the general counsel for the [[America First Policy Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://punchbowl.news/article/campaigns/maga-lawyer-luttrell/|title=MAGA lawyer eyes Luttrell seat|first1=-Ally|last1=Mutnick|first2=Jake|last2=Sherman}}</ref> She defeated Laura Jones in the [[2026 US House of Representatives elections]] to succeed [[Morgan Luttrell]] as the member-elect to the [[United States House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|TX|8}}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/6172661-jessica-steinmann-wins-texas-district/|title=Jessica Steinmann to succeed Morgan Luttrell in Texas House district|first=Max|last=Rego|date=November 4, 2026}}</ref>
